sources.snippet: FLUX.2 [klein] is a 4-billion-parameter rectified flow transformer from Black Forest Labs. It unifies text-to-image generation and image editing in a single compact architecture, delivering state-of-the-art quality with end-to-end inference in as low as 4 steps.
